canonicalization.operation: reject non-finite or wrong-width values, then element-wise clip to the shared float32 Panda bounds
canonicalization.training_statistics: compute from canonicalized actions over all 600 episodes and all local arm streams
canonicalization.training_targets: canonicalize before normalization and repeat padding
canonicalization.runtime: validate live action-space bounds exactly, temporal-ensemble decoded chunks, then canonicalize the selected physical action
canonicalization.checkpoint: embed contract version/hash and action-statistics hash; reject missing or mismatched metadata

fair_comparison.policy_training_data: all 600 successful episodes; no policy train/test split
fair_comparison.paired_validation: ACT, selector-off, and CARE must share the same task-indexed seed manifest
fair_comparison.legacy_checkpoint_policy: read-only audit only; never mix legacy checkpoints or branch labels into a contract-v1 formal run
